QuestInfo.name: Meeting with the Empress
QuestInfo.0: After finishing Kia's test, Kiku appeared. Talk to Kiku.
QuestInfo.1: You must go find the Empress at the center of Ereve. Follow the arrow to the left.
QuestInfo.2: You met Empress #p1101000# again. She looks weak, but has a warm smile.

0.0: #h0#, you're looking tougher. I think I'll let you be a Knight-in-Training.\r\nGo see the Empress at the center of Ereve. Just follow the arrows.

no.0: Not feeling tough enough? Relax, even the best knights started where you are today. Just work hard, and don't let me catch you slacking off.

1.0: #h0#, you look well. I am proud to see you take on this position.
1.1: I don't want you rush into battle yet, though. You will continue your training, yes?\r\nGo see Neinheart. He will tell you what to do.

npc.0: You shouldn't keep the Empress waiting. Head to the center of Ereve, #bright next to #p1101001##k. Follow the arrows.
